_about: DRAFT, not wired in (23 Oct 2026, content editor 4). Recipes for the garden room (garden-plan.md). Same atom format as the other rooms, `room` is 'garden'. Five atoms are COPIES of ones that live elsewhere today (`moved_from` names the room): when the garden opens, delete the originals from cuddlecore-world.json and flourish-world.json in the same commit. Garden atoms add `garden` (the hotspot key whose `ideas` should list the atom). Appliance ids stay the existing eight: a pizza oven or camp oven is tagged 'oven' (every recipe has a home-oven line), and fire-pit cooking is tagged 'bbq' (and 'oven' where it can swap). If the picker should get 'pizza-oven', 'camp-oven' and 'fire', add them to kitchen.js APPLIANCES and re-tag.

atoms.title: A sausage sizzle at home
atoms.hook: Sausage and fried onion in a slice of white bread, with sauce.
atoms.method_short: Grill the sausages until browned all over and fry sliced onion beside them. Fold both into a slice of bread with sauce, and eat it standing up like it's outside the hardware store.

seed.name: Sausage sizzle with fried onion
seed.why: A Saturday-morning classic, and it works in any back yard.

atoms.body: Grill the sausages until browned all over and fry sliced onion beside them. Fold both into a slice of bread with sauce, and eat it standing up like it's outside the hardware store.

atoms.title: Barbecued lamb chops with rosemary and lemon
atoms.hook: Lamb chops with rosemary, garlic and lemon, grilled until browned.
atoms.method_short: Rub lamb chops with oil, garlic, chopped rosemary and lemon zest. Grill over a hot barbecue for three or four minutes a side, then rest them under foil. Lemon over the top.

seed.name: Barbecued lamb chops with rosemary and lemon
seed.why: Lamb needs salt, a hot grill and a bit of patience.

atoms.body: Rub lamb chops with oil, garlic, chopped rosemary and lemon zest. Grill over a hot barbecue for three or four minutes a side, then rest them under foil. Lemon over the top.

atoms.title: Fish in a foil parcel with tomatoes and lemon
atoms.hook: Fish, tomatoes and lemon sealed in foil and steamed on the grill.
atoms.method_short: Set a fish fillet on foil with halved cherry tomatoes, lemon slices, oil and salt, and fold it into a tight parcel. Barbecue for twelve minutes, and open it away from your face. The steam is hot.

seed.name: Barbecued fish parcels with tomatoes and lemon
seed.why: One parcel each, and nothing to wash but the plate.

atoms.body: Set a fish fillet on foil with halved cherry tomatoes, lemon slices, oil and salt, and fold it into a tight parcel. Barbecue for twelve minutes, and open it away from your face. The steam is hot.

atoms.title: Charred corn with lime butter
atoms.hook: Sweetcorn grilled until it chars in spots, with lime butter.
atoms.method_short: Grill the cobs, turning, until charred in spots, about ten minutes. Brush with butter, squeeze lime over and add salt and coriander.

seed.name: Barbecued corn with lime butter
seed.why: Sweetcorn is at its best with a bit of char on it.

atoms.body: Grill the cobs, turning, until charred in spots, about ten minutes. Brush with butter, squeeze lime over and add salt and coriander.

atoms.title: Courgette, capsicum and red onion skewers
atoms.hook: Chunky vegetables on skewers, charred, with yoghurt and lemon.
atoms.method_short: Thread chunky courgette, capsicum and red onion on skewers and brush with oil and oregano. Grill, turning, until soft and charred at the edges, then serve with yoghurt and lemon. Soak wooden skewers first so they don't burn.

seed.name: Barbecued vegetable skewers with yoghurt and lemon
seed.why: Whatever the garden is overproducing, on a stick.

atoms.body: Thread chunky courgette, capsicum and red onion on skewers and brush with oil and oregano. Grill, turning, until soft and charred at the edges, then serve with yoghurt and lemon. Soak wooden skewers first so they don't burn.

atoms.title: Margherita from the pizza oven
atoms.hook: A thin pizza, blistered in two minutes in a very hot oven.
atoms.method_short: Stretch a ball of dough thin, spread it with passata and add torn mozzarella. Slide it into the hot oven for about two minutes, turning once, then add basil and oil. In a home oven, use the hottest setting on a preheated tray; it takes about eight minutes.

seed.name: Margherita pizza
seed.why: Fire does in two minutes what a home oven does in ten.

atoms.body: Stretch a ball of dough thin, spread it with passata and add torn mozzarella. Slide it into the hot oven for about two minutes, turning once, then add basil and oil. In a home oven, use the hottest setting on a preheated tray; it takes about eight minutes.

atoms.title: Yoghurt flatbreads with garlic butter
atoms.hook: Two-ingredient dough, cooked in minutes, brushed with garlic butter.
atoms.method_short: Mix equal weights of self-raising flour and yoghurt into a dough, and roll into rounds. Cook for two minutes a side on a very hot surface, then brush with melted garlic butter and parsley.

seed.name: Yoghurt flatbreads with garlic butter
seed.why: No yeast and no waiting, so they're ready while the pizza oven's still hot.

atoms.body: Mix equal weights of self-raising flour and yoghurt into a dough, and roll into rounds. Cook for two minutes a side on a very hot surface, then brush with melted garlic butter and parsley.

atoms.title: Camp-oven beef and kūmara stew
atoms.hook: Beef and vegetables in a cast-iron pot, left in the coals for hours.
atoms.method_short: Brown the beef in the camp oven, then add onion, carrots, stock and thyme and put the lid on. Leave it in the coals for about three hours, adding kūmara for the last hour. In a home oven at 160°C it takes the same time.

seed.name: Camp-oven beef and kūmara stew
seed.why: A heavy lid and a long afternoon do all the work.

atoms.body: Brown the beef in the camp oven, then add onion, carrots, stock and thyme and put the lid on. Leave it in the coals for about three hours, adding kūmara for the last hour. In a home oven at 160°C it takes the same time.

atoms.title: Damper from the camp oven
atoms.hook: A quick loaf of flour, butter and milk, baked in the pot.
atoms.method_short: Rub butter into self-raising flour with salt, mix in milk to a soft dough and shape it into a round. Bake with the lid on for about thirty minutes, until it sounds hollow when tapped. Eat warm with butter and golden syrup.

seed.name: Camp-oven damper
seed.why: Bread without yeast, from people who were a long way from a bakery.

atoms.body: Rub butter into self-raising flour with salt, mix in milk to a soft dough and shape it into a round. Bake with the lid on for about thirty minutes, until it sounds hollow when tapped. Eat warm with butter and golden syrup.

atoms.title: Apple crumble in the camp oven
atoms.hook: Soft apples under a crumble of oats and butter, baked with the lid on.
atoms.method_short: Slice apples into the pot and top with a crumbly mix of oats, flour, butter and sugar. Put the lid on, with a few coals on top, and bake for about thirty-five minutes until bubbling. In a home oven, use 180°C.

seed.name: Camp-oven apple crumble
seed.why: Heat from above and below, and the lid keeps it all in.

atoms.body: Slice apples into the pot and top with a crumbly mix of oats, flour, butter and sugar. Put the lid on, with a few coals on top, and bake for about thirty-five minutes until bubbling. In a home oven, use 180°C.

atoms.title: Potatoes baked in foil in the embers
atoms.hook: Buttery potatoes wrapped in foil and buried in the embers.
atoms.method_short: Toss halved potatoes with butter, rosemary, garlic and salt, and wrap them in a double layer of foil. Bury in the embers for about forty-five minutes. Open carefully, because the steam is hot.

seed.name: Foil-baked potatoes with rosemary
seed.why: Ten minutes of work, then you sit by the fire.

atoms.body: Toss halved potatoes with butter, rosemary, garlic and salt, and wrap them in a double layer of foil. Bury in the embers for about forty-five minutes. Open carefully, because the steam is hot.

atoms.title: Hot chocolate by the fire
atoms.hook: Milk warmed in a pot by the fire, with dark chocolate whisked in.
atoms.method_short: Warm the milk in a small pot over the fire and whisk in chopped dark chocolate until smooth. Add a little sugar to taste, pour into mugs and finish with a pinch of salt.

seed.name: Hot chocolate with dark chocolate and sea salt
seed.why: The pot on the fire makes it taste better, and I won't be argued with.

atoms.body: Warm the milk in a small pot over the fire and whisk in chopped dark chocolate until smooth. Add a little sugar to taste, pour into mugs and finish with a pinch of salt.

atoms.title: Table salad of tomato, cucumber and olives
atoms.hook: Big chunks of tomato and cucumber with olives, feta and oregano.
atoms.method_short: Cut tomatoes and cucumber into big chunks and add thin red onion, olives and crumbled feta. Dress with olive oil, lemon and oregano, and put the bowl in the middle of the table.

seed.name: Greek-style table salad
seed.why: Nothing to cook, so you can stay outside.

atoms.body: Cut tomatoes and cucumber into big chunks and add thin red onion, olives and crumbled feta. Dress with olive oil, lemon and oregano, and put the bowl in the middle of the table.

atoms.title: Fresh lemonade by the jug
atoms.hook: Lemon juice, sugar and cold water in a jug, with mint and ice.
atoms.method_short: Stir sugar into a cup of hot water until it dissolves. Add lemon juice, top up the jug with cold water and ice, and tear in some mint.

seed.name: Fresh lemonade with mint
seed.why: A jug on the table does more than anyone expects.

atoms.body: Stir sugar into a cup of hot water until it dissolves. Add lemon juice, top up the jug with cold water and ice, and tear in some mint.
